mainEntity.name: What if I’m not sure the damage is worth fixing right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: A common concern is that storm damage may be covered only if it is documented quickly and repaired to the right standard. If you are worried about budget, ask for a clear scope, photo documentation, and a repair plan that separates urgent protection from cosmetic finish work so you can decide what needs attention first.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask for a clear inspection, photos, and a repair scope before deciding. That helps separate urgent protection issues from purely cosmetic work so you can prioritize what matters most.
